Notes: Stout, and VERY fun climbing. Would be great to one day lead. TR was sketchy, you're looking at a big swing the whole time, esp by the 2 bolts/cruxes, and your bail option is going around the arete--not good. Lead would be safer, but getting 15ft up before you place first piece (blue totem i believe) is bouldery and not trivial. Route takes gear well and otherwise the rest of the climb is safer as a lead. Felt 10-. Crux 1 is traverse L-R through first bolt, finishing at major restable undercling. Body on left face and R hand (maybe for one move a foot) around the arete gets you up. Didn't follow arete to topout, traversed left and up to anchor, so crux 2 was short thinnnn crimp traverse R-L through second bolt. My beta was L foot out under thin crimps, get both tiny crimps set, then swap feet and step left to good foot. Top area, esp crux 1, required some hidden good feet. Fun move to get to the anchors, just watch you for the rattlesnake!
